history.summary: A 797 sqft freehold 3BR (compact) at The Addition (D13 Potong Pasir, Oxley, ~26 units) at $1.708M / $2,143 PSF, just 250m from Potong Pasir MRT. Superb transit but a tiny boutique development with only 6 URA txns and a high PSF above the area's resale norm.
history.rating_rationale: 250m to Potong Pasir NEL MRT and freehold are real positives, and score_1000 619 / on_frontier reflect that. But this is a ~26-unit boutique (former 8-unit en-bloc by Oxley) — thin liquidity, only a 6-txn series, and at $2,143 PSF it sits above recent project transactions (~$2,030 PSF avg) and the $2,130 median. The 797 sqft 'compact 3BR' commands a quantum-friendly $1.7M but at a rich PSF; resale-only appreciation is just 2.66%/yr. Location-led but priced full for a small dev.
red_flags: $2,143 PSF above ~$2,030 recent project txns and $2,130 median
Thin 6-txn URA series; resale appreciation only 2.66%/yr
797 sqft squeezed into a 3BR — efficient but tight layout
catalysts: 250m (3 min) to Potong Pasir NEL MRT — direct line to CBD/Orchard
City-fringe D13 with St Andrew's / SJI International schools nearby
